paragraphs.text: Open Markdown file links from the DSH conversation in Typora instead of the in-app preview.
# dsh-typora-links

Open Markdown file links from the DeepSeek Harness
conversation in **Typora** instead of the in-app
right-sidebar preview.

- **Plain click** on a local `.md` / `.markdown` link → Typora opens that file.
- **⌘ / Ctrl / Shift

/ Alt + click** → the shipped DSH preview (escape hatch).
- **Any failure** (missing file, host ref

usal, Typora unavailable) → falls back
to the shipped preview; a click is never lost.
- HTTP links,

non-Markdown files, the file tree, and the delivery cards keep
their original behavior.

The plugin is macOS-only in practice (it looks for the macOS Typora bundle),
does not change the sys

tem default application, and adds no host route, no
shell command, and no file access of its own. It

reuses DSH's authenticated
Session Remote for the native open.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness Desktop (Web client) `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`
- macOS
- Typora installed (`/Applications/T
ypora.app`, bundle id `abnerworks.Typora`)

s**) or edit `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`

then run `pnpm install` in `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop` and restart DSH.
## Use

Click a Markdown link in the conversation, for example a file the agent just
wrote. Typora comes to

the front with that file. Hold ⌘ (or Ctrl / Shift /
Alt) while clicking to keep the DSH preview.

Tool-row paths and `@file` mentions go through the same navigation entry, so
they open in Typora too
. The file tree and delivery cards are untouched.
## Configuration
Optional, in the bundle row of `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `appName` | `Typora` | Display name to match in the file's macOS handlers. |
| `bundleId` | `abner

works.Typora` | Bundle id to match; wins over the display name. |
| `extensions` | `[".md", ".markdo

wn"]` | Files taken away from the preview. Extensions may omit the dot. |
| `gestureWindowMs` | `900

` | How long after a click an open still counts as that click. |
| `requireExplicitApp` | `false` |
When true, a file without a matching Typora handler falls back to the preview instead of the default
le without a matching Typora handler falls back to the preview instead of the default application. |

When neither `appName` nor `bundleId` matches a handler, the plugin asks DSH to
open with the defaul
t application (which is Typora on a typical setup).
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Tab-scoped navigation (`openResourceIn`) is a different method, so the file
tree, the tab strip, and
the delivery cards are untouched.
## Security

- No host HTTP route, no command execution, no file reads or writes.
- The native open goes through

DSH's authenticated Session Remote; the Host
keeps validating path mapping and the application id.
-
The plugin only affects browser behavior and is unloaded with its bundle.
## Limits

- Only paths the Host filesystem can map are opened; an absolute path outside
the Session workspace

may be refused by the Host and falls back to the
preview.
- `dsh-resource://file/absolute/...` addre

sses (no session) are ignored.
- Depends on three internal DSH surfaces: `sidebarRight.openResource`

,
`workspaceFiles.stat`, and `session.openWorkspacePath` /
`workspacePathApplications`. A DSH upgrad

e that changes them disables the
plugin's behavior, but previews keep working.
- No Windows-specific

nges them disables the
plugin's behavior, but previews keep working.
- No Windows-specific launcher.
## Verify
[代码示例省略，未执行]

In the browser console, a failed native open logs `[typora-links] ...` with the
reason. The plugin r
egisters no settings page and no commands.
## Uninstall
[代码示例省略，未执行]

or remove the bundle from the profile and restart. Every behavior returns to
stock DSH.
